name: dsh-growth
description: Evidence-backed growth analysis tools for AARRR funnels, retention, experiments and MRR.

interface.shortDescription: A local-first growth operating system for Markdown data.
interface.longDescription: Growth Acquisition turns local Markdown, CSV and JSONL data into explainable AARRR funnels, cohort retention, MRR bridges, unit economics, growth experiments and WBR/MBR reports.
defaultPrompt: Run a read-only growth onboarding check for my project; show what is ready, partial, missing and not supported, then give me only the top two gaps to fix.
Run a growth review for my goal using the best available local data; show which sources you selected and what is missing.
Audit this growth plan and find the biggest evidence gaps.
Analyze my AARRR funnel and identify the highest-leverage bottleneck.
Turn this growth idea into a HADI experiment and RICE score it.
